notes.title: New Foothold Game mode
notes.content:
As always, a free content update has been added to the game! I'm very excited for all of you guys to start playing the new foothold game mode. We have spent the last few weeks on this and i'm very confident that our efforts have paid off. Basically in this new mode you have to protect your fellow soldiers around you, not just yourself. 

A new devblog will be coming soon. I'm so happy with the progress of this game and the feedback that has been given is just awesome. Thank you to all the people that have helped make this game what it is today!

-JakeFromStateFarm

notes.title: Update 1.02! Up And Over DLC.
notes.content: Thank you everyone for supporting our launch :) we are happy to annouce the first free DLC content update Up And Over! This gamemode has you capture trenches from the germans and avoid enemy fire. Hope you guys have a great time in it. Remember to keep and eye out for the next DLC. Thanks again guys.
